description: Enable or disable Reviewer Feedback for the job. confirm must be true in BOTH directions (the switch changes a live product surface). Disabling hides the feature but preserves every report, event, subject link, and reviewer grant for re-enable. Receipt-backed. Requires job_feedback:write.

confirm.description: Acknowledges this changes the live Reviewer Feedback surface.

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_job_feedback_set_enabled
